arc.energy_shape_notes: Two valleys, then one six-minute rising shelf. Intro quiet (-20.4dB mean), first statement -14.9dB, Valley I floor -26.0dB at 2:55, rebuild -15.4dB, Valley II sub-hole (centroid 281Hz at 5:20), then a long plateau 6:05-10:14 (mean -12.9dB) rising to peak 10:14-11:18 (mean -11.5dB, RMS max -10.2dB at 10:25). Outro holds peak level and closes with the track's loudest single peak (-0.9dB at 11:55), hard stop, no fade. No return to the opening key; the climax is the exit.

harmony.home_scale: Eb natural minor opening (Eb F Gb Ab Bb Cb Db) with ambiguous third; whole-step lift to F natural minor (F G Ab Bb C Db Eb) at ~2:30, locked for 9.5 minutes, 19 consecutive key windows at 0.71-0.84 confidence; ends in F minor at full volume
signature_devices: Third-ambiguity opening: both minor and major third of Eb present across the first 2 minutes; key detector flips maj/min at low confidence (0.45-0.53). Resolved by modulation, not by settling the third.
Whole-step key lift Eb minor -> F minor at ~2:30, inside the quietest valley (-26.0dB), then no further modulation for 9.5 minutes.
Two different valleys: Valley I is quiet (-26.0dB floor); Valley II is low (centroid 281Hz sub-hole at -23.5dB). Same job, different spectral means.
No leading tone, no dominant-function motion in key/chroma data; stasis after a single decision.
129.2 BPM rock-stable the whole track; one 123.0 per-minute reading at 10:00-11:00 treated as estimator wobble (uncorroborated by downbeat grid).
Downbeat grid: 378 downbeats, mean interval 1.892s (126.9 BPM for 4-beat bars, within tracker tolerance of 129.2). Grid never drops out, never shifts - no half-time, no accelerando.
Drum pattern inside the bar (kick/snare/hats/swing) NOT established by feature data - see report Honest Limits; 'four' is a generative prescription, not a measured claim.

tempo.feel: Locked grid at 129.2 BPM; the grid holds still so harmony and dynamics can be measured against it. No tempo change, no grid dropout, no accelerando. The rhythmic statement is steadiness itself.
